Name: Gravel Path Fix Mod
Author: Yunix93
Description:
This small Mod is just a new graphic for the Gravel Path to remove the ugly edges the original has.
I tryed to keep the look and color of the original one as good as possible, but it still look a little
different. Just look at the picture.

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[b]GoddessOfThieves[/b] did a nice new graphic that darkens the default cobblestone path to an almost black grey.
You should check it out too, he has also uploaded a version of his Mod including my Gravel Path for people who want both!
Here you can find it: http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/165/?
